reasons: The file is minimal and matches the standard Tailwind setup.

terms.meaning: a tool that transforms stylesheets during the build
a styling system built from small utility class names

used_by: the Next.js build (it loads this file by convention)

sections.name: config
sections.title: Styling plugin setting
sections.what: Tells the build to run styles through the Tailwind plugin, so utility class names in the code become real styles.
sections.why: Likely reason: Tailwind needs this hook to generate its styles during the build.
sections.watch_out: Removing the plugin silently breaks every utility class in the app.

summary: Turns on the Tailwind styling plugin for the build.
purpose: Let the app use Tailwind utility classes in its styles.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the plugin name; this is the standard hook Tailwind needs.
how: Exports one settings object naming the Tailwind plugin, which the build tool loads.
outputs: A settings object for the build tool.
risks: Removing the plugin silently breaks every utility class.
debug: If styles disappear, check the plugin is listed and the Tailwind package is installed.
